text: Did Helen know that the bell-rope was a dummy?
why: A plain question. Holmes has just revealed the bell-rope is a dummy, so the reader has good reason to ask whether Helen knew.

text: Did Helen know that the bell-rope was a dummy? — she did not know
why: Asserts as a fact that Helen did not know. The story never says what she knew about the bell-rope, so this answer is not yet established.

text: Did Helen know that the bell-rope was a dummy? — she knew and kept it back
id: q.helen_knew_dummy=she knew and kept it back
why: Framed as a possibility. Holmes has already accused Helen of screening her stepfather (¶70), so a reader has reason to consider that she is withholding something.
